column1: # realpath canonicalisation (fixtures in test-gate.sh; cwd is @TMP@/work).
# An ALLOW is re-checked after resolving symlinks: a secret target => PASS.
# A PASS with write targets is re-checked too: a persistence target => ASK.
# --- input redirects on compound commands belong to no single unit ---

column2: while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done < link-key
for i in 1; do cat; done < link-key
if true; then cat; fi < link-key
